annotations.text:
EVERY LABEL IS LIFTED FROM A SHIPPED SCREEN. On 2026-09-02 the real app was driven through a one-step test workout (import, Start Timer, SKIP, ▶, Finish session, Save, History, detail) and each board is that capture with the fewest words changed:

· Door: the workout detail's own second action, Start Timer, in its shipped place under Connect. Meta line loses the clause that is no longer true.
· Clock: the shipped Timer. Two words change — the STEP slot reads JUST ROW (the approved connected surface's word) and TARGET SPLIT reads Free (RATE already does). ELAPSED, UP NEXT · FINISH, Pause, ◀ ▶ and END are untouched. Finishing is the shipped ▶ then Finish this session?.
· Log door: the approved Just Row door, TIME only; provenance word TIMER from summaryModel's own PM5 / TIMER / LOGGED BY HAND set.
· History: a row with no avg and no distance has no second line in the shipped list. So: title and date.
· Detail: the shipped timer-row detail, verbatim, with INTERVALS absent because steps is [].

CONTRAST, computed (AA floor 4.5:1): ink/page 15.41 · ink-2/page 9.74 · ink-3/page 6.69 · ink-2/sunken 9.16 · ink-3/sunken 6.30 · on-color/accent (Save, Finish session) 5.94 · on-color/teal Connect 6.65 · accent/page (END, Delete) 5.35 · ink-4 placeholder/surface 5.29 (lowest; the shipped notes placeholder). Tap targets: buttons 52–56 px, arrows 52 px, pain cells 44 px.
